name: OMathMatRow
description: Represents a matrix row. The OMathMatRow is a member of the OMathMatRows collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathMatRow object.

properties.name: Args
properties.description: Returns an OMathArgs object that represents the arguments in a matrix row. Read-only.

properties.name: RowIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the ordinal position of a matrix row within the collection of matrix rows. Read/write.
